mentions.name: Single Threadripper Pro compute node
mentions.description: A self-funded, single Threadripper Pro compute node being built by hand to supply the hardware the author's bioinformatics timing experiments need, with the intent of adding it to Slurm as a module.
mentions.problem: Lack of hardware blocks the research, and the author cannot access national computing resources since the project is not-quite school affiliated.
mentions.source_excerpt: so I am trying to build a single threaripper pro node on my own. Hurts the wallet, but if added to slurm as module, this can have implications.
